children: Moncler's growth trend remains solid in some markets as the company enters its peak business season, analysts at Bernstein say in a note. The Italian luxury fashion group, known for its outerwear clothes, is facing weakness in Europe, a region that will likely remain under pressure in the third quarter amid unusually warm weather, the brokerage says. Despite this, the company seems to be experiencing positive momentum across Asia, while its U.S. business could get a boost in the coming quarters due to the opening of a flagship store on Fifth Avenue, the analysts say. Bernstein upgrades the stock to outperform from a market-perform rating. Shares are up 3.3%. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
